shared: Use case: identity-preserve. Game production sprite sheet for Crossroads Realms Beyond. Image1 is edit target identity, image2/3 style only. Match soft coloured edges, matte shading and neutral poses of our V207/V208 sprites. Coarse readable pixel art, square clusters and restrained palette, muted selective coloured contours, no continuous black outline, no glossy/high-resolution illustration, no white rim or ground shadow. Exactly SIX full-body poses in 3 columns by 2 rows, aligned equal-size cells: idle, movement A, movement B; primary, secondary, special. Head and torso fully FRONT FACING in EVERY pose, both eyes visible, no turning, no sideways lean, all attacks direction neutral with contained effects. Walk A and B must alternate LEFT and RIGHT foot clearly without moving torso/head or hopping. Same anatomy scale and baseline in all frames. Generous transparent margins and gutters, no labels/scenery. Genuinely transparent background. Normalized to80x80 so keep material shading simple.

specs.hazel_hex: Hazel Hex. Preserve warm fair skin, clean face with auburn hair on SIDES not beard, purple pointed witch hat with gold band, purple tunic, dark leggings, straw broom on viewer RIGHT. Keep recognizably a witch. Soften saturated orange/pink, muted auburn and plum fabric with subtle midtones. Reduce oversized head slightly, mature friendly capable expression. No giant eyes. Primary small central amber chain spark with broom still present; secondary holds broom upright close; special small cauldron at waist with green flecks. Do not lose broom in any frame.
specs.hearth_herald: Hearth Herald is a FEMALE ARMADILLO, not fox/cat/dog. Preserve orange-tan narrow muzzle, long narrow armadillo ears, ochre segmented domed SHELL visible around viewer RIGHT/back and curled plated tail, teal tunic with cream straps, russet sash, slate trousers/brown boots, brass amber lantern low on viewer LEFT. Make head/ears slightly smaller proportionate to torso; stocky but distinct armadillo anatomy. No furry cheek tufts. Soft matte muted shading. Primary lantern close to chest; secondary free hand cups small ember; special compact banner on viewer right and original lantern left. Front-facing neutral, no cheek profile.
specs.cat: Crossroads Cat charcoal-grey small CAT with cream muzzle/paws, turquoise eyes and PURPLE SCARF. The tall upright dark shape is its TAIL, NOT a hat. NO HAT. Change only its silhouette to a lower curled tail rising behind head no higher than ears, still recognizably cat tail. Body proportions remain small animal, no humanoid clothing or limbs. Idle seated-ready four-paw posture; two gentle walking paw alternations (no new legs); primary paws close front spin-ready; secondary crouch; special compact alert stealth stance. Maintain front-facing neutral, tail present all poses, subtle matte fur shading.
specs.echo_dancer: Echo Dancer medium brown/tan human male travelling ribbon swordsman of Folded Coast. Preserve short wavy charcoal hair, aqua sleeveless tunic, gold waist sash, dark teal trousers, pale grey boots, slender curved icy blue sabre on viewer RIGHT. Scarf on viewer LEFT is folded IVORY FABRIC not wings. Refine it to small cloth folds with muted shadows, shoulder/arms clearly readable; no wide pale blocks or wings obscuring body. Slightly clearer eyes/facial features but tiny simple pixels. Primary sabre raised close to torso, secondary scarf flick compact at chest, special 3 very small pale ribbon memories near hands. Equipment stays on same side in all frames. No generic wizard/armour.
specs.twisterspell: Lyra Galeweaver confident daring ADULT female wind sorcerer. Preserve silver-white long windswept hair, fair skin, navy/slate blue and pale silver palette, blue cropped fitted top showing a little midriff, SHORT SKIRT and dark high boots, slim wind staff on viewer RIGHT. REMOVE large pointed witch hat entirely. Replace it with a distinctive asymmetrical SMALL stormcloth hood partly raised behind one side of her head, other side folded at shoulder, open face and hair visible. No pointed hat, no witch silhouette, no big cape obscuring crop top. Slightly angular toned face, confident brows and poised adventurous stance. Body a little taller and more readable, normal adult hero height, not tiny head under hat. No sexual pose. Primary hands compact charge gust with staff present, secondary staff with small wind crescent, special compact cyclone ribbons close to body. All front-facing neutral, no directional attack. Gently alternate both legs in walk poses.
